WITH executions_cleaned AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(ordersmark, '__NULL__') as order_ref,
    fillcount
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE fillcount IS NOT NULL AND fillcount > 0
),
order_avg_fills AS (
  SELECT 
    order_ref,
    AVG(fillcount) as avg_fill
  FROM executions_cleaned
  GROUP BY order_ref
),
benchmark_1 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill) as b1
  FROM order_avg_fills
),
above_b1 AS (
  SELECT 
    oaf.order_ref,
    oaf.avg_fill,
    oaf.avg_fill - b1.b1 as excess_1
  FROM order_avg_fills oaf
  CROSS JOIN benchmark_1 b1
  WHERE oaf.avg_fill > b1.b1
),
benchmark_2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill) as b2
  FROM above_b1
),
above_b2 AS (
  SELECT 
    ab1.order_ref,
    ab1.avg_fill,
    ab1.excess_1,
    ab1.avg_fill - b2.b2 as excess_2
  FROM above_b1 ab1
  CROSS JOIN benchmark_2 b2
  WHERE ab1.avg_fill > b2.b2
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_fill) as avg_fill_quantity,
  AVG(excess_1) as avg_first_excess,
  AVG(excess_2) as avg_second_excess
FROM above_b2
